notes.title: Patch Notes 0.1
notes.notes: [h2]Changelog Patch 0.1[/h2][p][/p][h3]Improvements:[/h3][list][*][p]When you go to map scene, camera follow mode is now set as default camera mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Now you can choose to set playable window borderless yes/no.[/p][/*][*][p]Now the game use the hardware cursor mode for more perfomance.[/p][/*][*][p]Every day/night cycle now  a notification reminds you how many days remains to quest expiration.[/p][/*][*][p]Totally rebalancing of equipments and bonus/malus calculation. A New Game start it is advisable.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Bugs:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed overlay bug when King sends new fresh troops.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where, for some reason, missions would not expire.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a lot of translation strings.[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor fixes.[/p][/*][/list]
